import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Get top 10 dog breeds by primary breed
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].dropna().value_counts().nlargest(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=top_breeds.values, y=top_breeds.index, palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (Primary Breed)')
plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
